judgments.reason: The model text states intended bids and outcomes but does not articulate the claimed mechanism (that commission is included before payment or that an over-bid can win because commission is applied first). The transcript shows normal resolutions and payments; no discrepancy demonstrating rule-order precedence is explained or observed.

The model did not articulate the mechanism that waiting reveals committed sealed rival bid values before the focal player can commit and respond. The transcript shows standard sealed-bid commits and resolved lots; no explanation or evidence of privileged precommit information was given.

The model did not describe or demonstrate an early settlement discrepancy (settling before the normal horizon while lots remain unsold). The final state shows all lots sold and settlement accepted; no early-terminal anomaly is articulated.

The model did not explain or demonstrate that catalog purchases received the three-coin auction commission. The transcript and model text describe catalog buys as distinct and show only auction winners receiving commission; no mechanism or observed instance of commission on purchases was articulated.
